title: KODEX — KRAD: radiation-control
description:
KODEX — KRAD (radiation-control). impurity-seeding radiation-control evaluator — maps a seeded impurity + radiated-power fraction to core Zeff penalty and P_rad from the H9 seeding scan. Small scan; full impurity-transport (SOLPS + impurity) = fidelity upgrade

Benchmark: impurity-seeding radiation evaluator: 3 impurities (Ar, N, Ne); least core dilution = Ar

Part of KODEX, the Kronos Family of Codes — a benchmarked AI/ML fusion surrogate suite with calibrated uncertainty and an abstention gate (predict(x) → (y, uncertainty, in_domain)). Provenance: references 10.5281/zenodo.21842371. Home: https://kronosfusionenergy.com/kodex/krad · suite: https://github.com/KronosFE/kronos-ml. Licensed under Apache-2.0. Honest card preserved verbatim.
